title: Mycielski Cantor independent set for dense-open binary relations
abstract: Every nonempty open subset U of a perfect Polish space X contains a closed topological embedding e of Cantor space Nat -> Bool such that every ordered pair of distinct image points lies in each member of a countable family of dense-open subsets R_n of X × X. Coordinated finite refinements enforce all ordered pairs, have closure nesting and vanishing diameter; ambient completeness yields the Cantor limit map. Single-Cantor binary-relation scope only; no novelty claim.
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
